nodes.description: Counter of minted tokens; drives supply cap and tesla draw indexing.
Hard cap of 7777 NFTs, also used as modulo for the raffle.
Mutable base URI prefix used by tokenURI.
Fixed mint price of 0.042 ether checked in buy().
Sale start timestamp, settable by owner, compared with block.timestamp.
Winner of the raffle, written from pseudo-random hash.
ERC721 token name.
ERC721 token symbol.
Per-user nonce map for meta transactions; incremented after verification.
Owner address used by the onlyOwner access control modifier.
EIP-712 domain separator written during initialization.
Guard flag for the initializer modifier.
Payable public mint: checks start time, price and supply, mints to msg.sender.
Owner-only free mint to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only transfer of the whole contract balance via transfer().
Owner-only setter for the sale start timestamp.
Owner-only setter for baseTokenURI.
View returning baseTokenURI concatenated with the token id.
Private helper returning _currentTokenId + 1.
Internal pseudo-random generator built from block.coinbase, block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
Private incrementer that also runs the Tesla raffle when MAX_SUPPLY - 1 is reached.
Override resolving the real sender through ContextMixin.msgSender for meta-tx support.
Verifies a signed meta transaction, burns a nonce and self-calls with the user address appended.
Internal mint that updates balances/owners and emits Transfer.
Constructor wiring ERC721 name/symbol, EIP-712 domain and owner.
Modifier comparing owner() with _msgSender().
Private hook performing the IERC721Receiver callback on safe mint/transfer.
Internal view verifying the EIP-712 signature via ecrecover.
Caller-controlled address; relayer in meta transactions, beneficiary in buy().
Miner-influenced timestamp used for sale gating and randomness.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) external value transfer.
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) arbitrary low-level self call.
Randomness derived from block.coinbase, block.timestamp and block.difficulty, predictable by miners.
ownerOf(_currentTokenId - 1000..11000 + rand) index arithmetic that can underflow and revert.
External callback into a receiver contract during safe mint/transfer.
Recipient address of mintTo.
Next token id computed inside mintTo.
New sale start timestamp supplied by the owner.
New base URI string supplied by the owner.
Token id argument of tokenURI.
Signer address of the meta transaction.
Raw calldata to be executed after appending the user address.
ECDSA signature r component.
ECDSA signature s component.
ECDSA signature v component.
MetaTransaction struct built from the nonce, sender and signature payload.
Pseudo-random number modulo 1000 used as raffle offset.
Hash of the ten ownerOf lookups plus msg.sender.
Next token id computed inside buy().
Internal safe mint that calls _mint and then checks the receiver callback.

edges.reason: buy() gates minting on block.timestamp >= startTime.
buy() reads startTime for the timestamp comparison.
buy() reads _currentTokenId to enforce the supply cap.
buy() compares _currentTokenId against MAX_SUPPLY.
buy() requires msg.value == NFT_price.
buy() mints the new token directly to msg.sender.
buy() calls _getNextTokenId().
buy() calls ERC721._mint on the payment path.
buy() calls _incrementTokenId() after minting.
_getNextTokenId() reads _currentTokenId before adding 1.
mintTo() calls _getNextTokenId().
mintTo() calls ERC721._mint.
mintTo() calls _incrementTokenId() after minting.
mintTo() checks _currentTokenId < MAX_SUPPLY.
mintTo() reads _currentTokenId for the supply check.
mintTo() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
_incrementTokenId() reads _currentTokenId for the cap check and raffle indexes.
_incrementTokenId() writes _currentTokenId++.
_incrementTokenId() calls randomHash() when the supply threshold is hit.
randomHash() mixes block.timestamp into the keccak preimage.
Timestamp-derived value feeds the predictable raffle randomness.
randomHash() result is the source of the weak raffle randomness.
_incrementTokenId() executes ownerOf(_currentTokenId - N + rand) which can underflow.
_currentTokenId is an operand of the raffle index subtractions.
rand offsets the underflow-prone ownerOf index computation.
_incrementTokenId() assigns the raffle winner to teslaOwner.
withdraw() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw() performs payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance).
withdraw() reads _owner through owner() as the transfer recipient.
onlyOwner compares owner() (backed by _owner) with _msgSender().
onlyOwner authorization ultimately derives from the untrusted caller identity.
set_start_time() writes startTime.
set_start_time() is protected by onlyOwner.
setBaseUri() writes baseTokenURI.
setBaseUri() is protected by onlyOwner.
tokenURI() reads baseTokenURI when building the URI.
_msgSender() falls back to msg.sender when the caller is not the contract itself.
onlyOwner uses _msgSender(), which can be spoofed via appended meta-transaction calldata.
executeMetaTransaction() reads nonces[userAddress] to build the MetaTransaction.
executeMetaTransaction() increments the user nonce to prevent replay.
executeMetaTransaction() calls verify() before executing.
userAddress selects the nonce and forms metaTx.from.
functionSignature is hashed and appended to the self-call payload.
The relayer msg.sender is emitted and becomes the outer caller context.
executeMetaTransaction() performs an arbitrary low-level self call.
The self call can re-enter executeMetaTransaction or other state-changing functions because state is not fully settled before the external call.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external IERC721Receiver callback to an attacker-controlled contract.
_safeMint() calls _mint() before the receiver check.
_safeMint() calls _checkOnERC721Received for the receiver hook.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor initializes the EIP-712 domain separator through _initializeEIP712.
Constructor sets _owner to _msgSender(), i.e. the deploying caller.
Initializer modifier flips inited to true during construction/initialization.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient argument consumed only by mintTo to select the mint recipient.
newTokenId is a temporary value produced and immediately consumed inside mintTo.
time is a transient argument whose only use is the startTime assignment in set_start_time.
_uri is a transient argument written directly to baseTokenURI inside setBaseUri.
_tokenId is a transient argument used only to build the string returned by tokenURI.
userAddress is a transient argument used to index nonces and build the MetaTransaction.
functionSignature is a transient payload hashed and appended to the self-call.
sigR is passed straight into the ecrecover check inside verify.
sigS is passed straight into the ecrecover check inside verify.
sigV is passed straight into the ecrecover check inside verify.
metaTx is a temporary struct built and consumed within executeMetaTransaction.
rand is a temporary offset used only in the underflow-prone ownerOf index arithmetic.
txHash is a temporary hash computed and immediately reduced modulo MAX_SUPPLY inside _incrementTokenId.
newTokenId is a temporary value produced and consumed within buy().
